data.name: Ravengate: The King’s Last March
data.detailed_description:
Ravengate: The King’s Last March is a medieval-themed, story-driven, decision-making strategy RPG set in a kingdom on the brink of collapse. As the newly enthroned king, listen to the people's pleas, manage your treasury, command your troops, contain rebellions, and strive to keep your kingdom afloat against internal and external threats. Every day, your decisions will impact the kingdom's future: sometimes you'll respond to the pleas of a starving populace, sometimes you'll evaluate your generals' military plans, and other times you'll face assassinations, war news, and political intrigue.

  • Kingdom Management:
    Rule as a medieval king. Make decisions, listen to your people, review incoming reports, and shape the future of your kingdom. Orders given in the throne room will have real consequences beyond the castle walls.

  • Choice and Consequence System:
    A decision that seems right in the moment may lead to greater problems as the story unfolds.

  • Medieval Story:
    Experience a dark medieval story shaped by intrigue, betrayal, and survival. The king’s struggle does not end on the battlefield; it continues within the palace itself.

  • Diplomacy and Kingdom Relations: 

    Manage your relationships with other kingdoms, make diplomatic decisions, and remember that war is not always the only answer

  • Palace Intrigue and Betrayal:
    The greatest threat to the kingdom is not always beyond the walls. Sometimes, it stands closer to the king than anyone expects.

  • Quest and Investigation System:
    Complete quests, question commanders, soldiers, and other characters connected to each event, and search for the truth behind conflicting statements.

  • Consequences of War:
    Wars shape the future of the kingdom. Fallen soldiers, wounded commanders, and broken diplomacy can change the course of the game later on.

  • Resource and Risk Management:
    Manage your city, treasury, army, and people while keeping unrest under control. If rebellion begins to rise, you must act before it spreads.

  • Branching Story Progression:
    Some events unfold differently depending on the choices you make. Punishing the wrong person may give the real culprit more time to act.

  • Single-Player Medieval Experience:
    Ravengate: The King’s Last March offers a single-player medieval experience built around story, war, choices, and atmosphere.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
